name: Neck Mobility
description: Tiny, easy neck movements for a long day at a screen.

steps.title: Sit tall
steps.text: Rest your hands in your lap and let your shoulders relax away from your ears.

steps.title: Look side to side
steps.text: Turn your head slowly to look over one shoulder, then slowly to the other. Keep it small and easy, three times each side.

steps.title: Ear toward shoulder
steps.text: Gently tilt one ear toward its shoulder without lifting the shoulder, then switch sides.

steps.title: Chin down, then up
steps.text: Let your chin drop a little, then come back to the middle. Keep every movement small. Move slowly and only as far as feels comfortable. Stop if anything hurts.
